==About==
This template is a modified version of the {{tl|Quote}} template. It is used for quotes that were originally spoken in a foreign language and where a translation is available in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] (English) and was used to present the [[Wookieepedia:Quote of the Day|Quote of the Day]] on the wiki [[Main Page]].

==Usage instructions==
<pre><nowiki>{{Quotetrans3|quote|translation|attribution|source}}</nowiki></pre>

===Notes===
*If any text is assigned to the ''source'' field, it will be rendered as a browser [[Wikipedia:Tooltip|tooltip]].

==Example==
===Code===
<code><nowiki>{{Quotetrans3|Gar nioz-ko ren fal skadzit!|Nice. I try to be civil&mdash;an' all I get's a 'thank you' that'd make a corona sailor blush!|Shem-Larn|Star Wars 51: Resurrection of Evil}}</nowiki></code>

===Result===
{{Quotetrans3|Gar nioz-ko ren fal skadzit!|Nice. I try to be civil&mdash;an' all I get's a 'thank you' that'd make a corona sailor blush!|Shem-Larn|Star Wars (1977) 51}}
